## Ctx.handleCommandCaptionArgsAudio() method

Route function for audioCaptionCommandPayload with slash command and arg match intent `this.data.name`

**Signature:**

```typescript
/** @virtual */
handleCommandCaptionArgsAudio?(): Promise<any>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;any&gt;

## Remarks

Triggered by audio with caption command and args.

## Example

this.data.name = "/start 123 aaa" &amp;&amp; this.msgAudio

